title: The pathological roles of intrinsically disordered proteins in lysosomal acidification dysfunction in neurodegenerative diseases
title_zh: 内在无序蛋白在神经退行性疾病中溶酶体酸化功能障碍的病理作用
abstract: Abstract Neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer’s disease (AD), frontotemporal dementia (FTD), and Parkinson’s disease (PD) are characterized by the accumulation of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs), including amyloid-β (Aβ), tau, and α-synuclein (αSyn). These proteins disrupt neuronal homeostasis through toxic aggregation, impaired proteostasis, and progressive neurodegeneration, in part via dysfunction of the autophagy-lysosomal pathway (ALP). A central feature of this impairment is defective vacuolar-type (H + )-ATPase (V-ATPase) function, leading to lysosomal deacidification and reduced degradative capacity. Pathological IDP species converge on V-ATPase through direct interactions with its subunits or by perturbing its assembly, while also exerting protein-specific effects, including lysosomal membrane destabilization, impaired hydrolase activity, and disrupted endolysosomal trafficking. These combined mechanisms create a reciprocal relationship between lysosomal dysfunction and IDP accumulation, in which impaired lysosomal degradation further promotes the persistence and aggregation of pathological IDP species. This review synthesizes current insights into the molecular interplay between IDPs and lysosomal acidification across AD, FTD, and PD, and highlights how these processes contribute to disease progression. We further discuss emerging therapeutic strategies aimed at restoring lysosomal function. These findings underscore lysosomal dysfunction as a common feature of IDP-driven neurodegeneration and a potential therapeutic target across these disorders.
abstract_zh: 摘要：阿尔茨海默病（AD）、额颞叶痴呆（FTD）和帕金森病（PD）等神经退行性疾病的特征是内在无序蛋白（IDP）如淀粉样β（Aβ）、tau和α-突触核蛋白（αSyn）的积累。这些蛋白通过毒性聚集、蛋白稳态受损和逐步神经退行性变，部分通过自噬-溶酶体途径（ALP）功能障碍，破坏神经元稳态。该功能障碍的核心特征是溶酶体型（H⁺）-ATP酶（V-ATPase）功能缺陷，导致溶酶体去酸化和降解能力下降。病理性IDP物种通过与V-ATPase亚基的直接相互作用或扰乱其组装而聚焦于V-ATPase，同时还产生蛋白质特异性效应，包括溶酶体膜失稳、水解酶活性受损和内溶酶体运输紊乱。这些机制共同形成溶酶体功能障碍与IDP积累之间的相互关系，溶酶体降解受损进一步促进病理IDP物种的持续和聚集。本综述整合了当前关于IDP与溶酶体酸化在AD、FTD和PD中的分子相互作用的见解，并强调这些过程如何促进疾病进展。我们还讨论了旨在恢复溶酶体功能的新兴治疗策略。这些发现强调了溶酶体功能障碍作为IDP驱动神经退行性变的共同特征，以及在这些疾病中潜在的治疗靶点。
